en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a quiet town square and adjoining street lined with multi‑story buildings with gabled roofs. Shop signs are visible at street level, including a perfumery, hairdresser, and wine shop. The cobblestone street is mostly empty except for a few pedestrians. At the top, printed text identifies the location as Borna near Leipzig and specifies the view of the market and Pegauerstrasse.
